aggregate.cohort: 54 causal-pool compositions; distinct from the original 27-composition validation cohort
aggregate.evaluation_role: post-study evaluation; not a new calibration or an admission decision
limitations: The original validation MAE does not describe accuracy on these pool compositions.
FastCat data have been used for training, development, validation and pool evaluation; no untouched cohort remains for another held-out validation.
Single-run labels do not establish composition-specific measurement uncertainty.

evidence_limit: Publication of the aggregate result previously recorded by the study operator; not a recomputation from raw outcomes or independent validation. Underlying per-run records are not included.
